The company facilitates rapid discovery and development of predictive models, improving patient recruitment and data management. Its solutions cater to pharmaceutical and medical device sectors, enhancing research and regulatory processes.

product.name: Openda
product.description: A proprietary data platform providing secure, instant access to millions of de-identified medical imaging studies and health records for research and AI development.

product.name: Incognito
product.description: A de-identification tool that removes protected health information from DICOM images and medical text reports, ensuring compliance with HIPAA Safe Harbor standards.

product.name: Custom Dataset Curation Service
product.description: A service to collaborate with clients to curate specific, complex cohorts of de-identified patient imaging datasets tailored to research needs.

product.name: Pre-packaged Multimodal Dataset
product.description: A ready-to-use dataset containing over one million de-identified medical imaging studies and radiology reports, delivered within days for research and development.
